title: Paper Setting Documents - Exam Cell - KIT's College of Engineering Kolhapur
text:
PAPER SETTING DOCUMENTS — EXAM CELL, KITCOEK

The Exam Cell at KITCOEK provides standardized paper setting documents for faculty members conducting examinations under the Autonomous scheme.

DOCUMENTS AVAILABLE
The following paper setting document templates are available for download:

1. Mid Semester Examination (MSE / ISE)
   - Question paper format and marking scheme template
   - Instructions for paper setters
   - Bloom's Taxonomy level mapping guidelines

2. End Semester Examination (ESE)
   - Question paper format for theory subjects
   - Practical examination documents
   - Marks distribution guidelines

3. Makeup Examination
   - Makeup exam paper setting guidelines
   - Eligibility criteria documentation format

4. Summer Term Examination
   - Question paper format for summer term
   - Special examination guidelines

EXAM CELL CONTACT
For exam-related queries:
- Visit the Exam Cell office on campus
- Email: examcell@kitcoek.in
- Website: https://www.kitcoek.in/paper-setting-documents

EXAM TYPES AT KITCOEK
Under the Autonomous system, KITCOEK conducts:
- In-Semester Evaluation (ISE): 30 marks — continuous assessment throughout semester
- Mid-Semester Examination (MSE): 20 marks
- End-Semester Examination (ESE): 50 marks
- Total: 100 marks per subject
- Practical/Oral: As per subject requirements
